categories.main_business_segments: Qitian Technology Group primarily operates in digital marketing and value-added services for bank cards. Its main business segments include digital life marketing, bank card value-added marketing, data services, insurance brokerage, and software-as-a-service (SaaS). The company focuses on providing comprehensive digital marketing solutions, especially for financial institutions such as banks and insurance companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages platform-based technology capabilities including self-developed business middle platforms, data middle platforms, digital open platforms, and SaaS platforms. It integrates big data, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, and digital marketing technologies to deliver precise, efficient, and personalized marketing solutions. The use of AI, including generative AI, enhances marketing productivity and ROI visualization, while the company continuously iterates its technology platforms to maintain industry leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qitian Technology mainly serves financial institutions, including over 100 banks such as China UnionPay, major state-owned banks, joint-stock banks, and commercial banks. It also serves insurance companies, securities firms, trusts, internet companies, telecom operators, automotive enterprises, and government agencies. The company’s digital marketing services target these sectors with a focus on banking and financial services marketing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with all reported revenues generated domestically. Its registered and operational offices are located in Shanghai and Jiangsu province, with subsidiaries also in other Chinese cities such as Nanjing and Hefei. There is no significant international geographic coverage reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qitian Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital marketing supply chain. It acts as a service provider integrating upstream digital product resources (e.g., telecom, energy, internet platforms) and delivering marketing and value-added services to downstream financial institutions and other corporate clients. The company also manages digital product distribution and marketing platforms, bridging upstream suppliers and downstream end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening integration and synergy across its business units, enhancing platform iteration and technology upgrades, and accelerating AI applications in digital marketing. It prioritizes capability building in market, solution, and operational domains, and aims to expand horizontally into non-financial sectors while deepening vertical penetration in existing clients. R&D efforts focus on payment marketing platforms, comprehensive operation platforms, and digital marketing service platforms, with significant investment in AI-driven marketing solutions and big data analytics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through digital marketing service fees, including comprehensive marketing solutions, value-added bank card services, and data services. The company also earns income from credit card installment services and software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings. Revenue is recognized based on contract fulfillment, with some effect-based or performance-based fee structures introduced to meet client demands.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Qitian Technology positions itself as a leading digital marketing service provider in the financial sector, especially banking. It emphasizes its long-term stable partnerships with major banks and financial institutions, strong technology platforms, and comprehensive lifecycle user management solutions as competitive advantages. The company faces intense competition in the digital marketing industry, which is characterized by rapid innovation and increasing market entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 627 million, a 35.7% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 214 million, though the loss narrowed compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at RMB 1.33 billion with net assets of RMB 552 million. The company has experienced revenue contraction due to market competition and client budget tightening but is implementing operational optimizations and technology investments to stabilize and grow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qitian Technology offers a one-stop, full-process digital marketing solution platform that integrates upstream product resources with advanced technology platforms to deliver precise, efficient, and personalized marketing services. Its differentiation lies in deep industry expertise, especially in financial institutions, strong platform-based technology capabilities, AI-driven marketing innovation, and comprehensive lifecycle user management. The company’s ability to customize solutions rapidly and provide 24/7 secure, responsive services enhances customer satisfaction and loyalty.
